description: A for directive whose key and value variables share a name binds the name to the value
notes: The spec doesn't say whether the key and value variables may share a name. hashicorp/hcl accepts it: parseTemplateParts (hclsyntax/parser_template.go) doesn't compare the names, and ForExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) assigns the key and then the value to the same variable, so the value wins.
